description: An empty index list now passes validation against a nonempty output allocation.
trigger: Call the bound exl3_mgemm with rank-two indices of shape (1,0), positive allocated input and output batch sizes and otherwise compatible dimensions that yield a positive selected SM count.
expected_behavior: Reject an empty active set explicitly or return without a launch.
actual_behavior: Both effective counts become zero, grid z becomes zero, and the wrapper still attempts the cooperative launch. The inspected attention call has no indices and the three ordinary fused expert calls use the configured top-k count; no stock empty-list caller was identified.

verification.description: Checked that (1,8,0) now passes and clamps to (0,0); inspected the subsequent grid construction and launch.
verification.limits: No CUDA error or return value was measured.

introductions.rationale: This wrapper change accepts an empty index dimension with allocated output slots, then clamps the active batch to zero.
